pre_registered_predictions: P-carried: every carried claim (G, L2, R1, R2v4, R3v4, R3L, R2x, RHOR, R5, R6v4) reproduces its run4.json / run5.json values BIT-EXACTLY (92/92 round-5 metrics; 29/29 round-4 metrics). Verdicts all PASS.

P-RLONG: (a) anchor identity: the wd=0 horizon arm reproduces D = 30174 bit-exact (vs design5 AND design6). (b) MAIN ARM wd = 3e-4 (registered dose): weight decay on Wc only, form Wc <- Wc - lr*wd*Wc once per step after the data-gradient update and before the EMA update; registered stop rule min(5e5, D+2000). REGISTERED EXPECTATION (chosen per the task's requirement): the two-phase shape is ELIMINATED WITHIN THE REGISTERED WINDOW at this dose — design6 measured NO divergence through the full 5e5-step stop (D = null, executed_to = 500000, all losses finite), so the lifetime extension is CAP-CENSORED at > 5e5/30174 = 16.5706x. REGISTERED FACTOR GATE (honest band): lifetime D extends by >= 2x the undecayed D (the task's band floor; band 2-10x) — the censoring floor >16.57x satisfies it; run6 must reproduce D_main/executed_to bit-exact vs design6. The runaway mechanism SURVIVES IN PRINCIPLE (decay 9e-5/step << runaway 7.9e-2/step): 'eliminated within the window' is the registered outcome, not global elimination. (c) Phase-1 mechanism receipt: the slow |Wc| inflation rate at wd=3e-4 is NEGATIVE (design6: -1.003e-5/step — net deflation; Wc norm 11.891 -> 9.770 at 20k -> 5.535 at 100k) while Wp GROWS (12.090 -> 22.661 at 20k) — the loss stays at the floor because the composition Wp.Wc re-balances (loss homogeneity), exactly the registered mechanism. (d) PLASTICITY TOLERANCE (registered): in the SAME decayed configuration the carried learning gates still pass UNRELAXED — g_wd < 0.5 (design6: 0.35080207176693745), r1_wd < 0.5 (0.17081682633549816), drift_wd < 0.01 (0.0026070231808889704); tight bands registered: g_wd in [0.345, 0.357], r1_wd in [0.165, 0.177] — degradation vs the undecayed anchors (0.3492/0.1693) is <= 1% relative. (e) DOSE-RESPONSE (registered finding, gates nothing): the house-recipe-order dose wd = 1e-4 extends life only 1.5938x (D = 48091, BELOW the 2x band floor) and the two-phase shape PERSISTS there (runaway 0.07922435292937978/step >= 100x the slow rate 5.3038e-6/step — ratio 14937.5); wd = 1e-3 shows net deflation (slow rate -2.889e-5/step) and no divergence through the 1e5 contrast cap. The slow-phase rate flips sign between wd = 1e-4 and 3e-4: the longevity response to decay dose is steep and monotone (+1.938e-5 -> +5.304e-6 -> -1.003e-5 -> -2.889e-5 /step).

P-R3D: (a) MECHANISM (registered): the depth deficit has TWO components — (i) residual-scale aliasing: the fixed 124-tick baseline's per-cell sd collapses with depth (sd_sum 1.7285 at depth 400 -> 1.2168 at 1200 -> 1.1181 at 2000 -> 1.3795 at the 2200 finding site) while the z-normalizer was designed to be scale-free; (ii) novelty-gap decay: the injected block's absolute surprise gap collapses as the model's input-manifold coverage grows (raw gap 0.0563 -> 0.0308 -> -0.0046 -> 0.0298). Decomposition at the finding site: deficit factor 0.7196 = gap factor 0.5299 x (1/0.7981 sd-aliasing). (b) REGISTERED LAW (the operational fix): SCALE-ANCHORED SURPRISE STATISTIC — z_anchored(depth) = z_carried(depth) x [sd_sum(depth 400)/sd_sum(depth)], where sd_sum(depth) is the summed per-cell baseline sd of the CARRIED round-4-form study at that depth; the anchor is the registered shallow operating point, so the multiplier at depth 400 is EXACTLY 1.0 and the round-4 numbers stay BIT-IDENTICAL at the shallow settings (the carried R3v4 claim is untouched — the anchored reading is an additional registered reading of the same windows). The law removes ONLY the residual-scale-aliasing component (the component round-5 receipted as the priced lever); it does not touch the novelty component. (c) REGISTERED GATES (unchanged 3.0 gate, never retuned): z_anchored >= 3.0 at BOTH registered depth-2000-class sites — the round-5 finding site (train 2200, wStart 2201): design6 3.192747264380909 in [3.10, 3.30]; the nominal depth-2000 site (train 2000, wStart 2001): design6 3.4081658202992458 in [3.31, 3.51]. (d) Anchored at depth 400 == 3.540717612984098 == run4.metrics.r3v4_z_ratio BIT-EXACT. (e) HONEST LIMITS receipted, gate nothing: at the k=3 site (depth 1200) the anchored statistic remains BELOW the gate (2.2614 < 3.0) — that site's deficit is NOVELTY-dominated (gap factor 0.547) and no fix is claimed there; the pure window-scaling candidates are REJECTED as site-fragile (candD whole-window-proportional: 4.8052 at nominal-2000 but 1.2187 at the finding site; candA extended-preceding-baseline: 3.3413 at the finding site but 1.4772 at nominal-2000) — neither survives both sites, so neither is the law; the carried statistic's values at all sites are receipted bit-exact (2200 == design5's 2.5480705541027127).
